events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, launched on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being its very first music video.

angles.name: Radio Star irony
angles.copy: On this day in 1981, MTV launched with 'Video Killed The Radio Star'... how ironic for us, eh?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album, 'Definitely Maybe,' on this day in 1994.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Rewind to 1969: The Woodstock Festival began on this day, bringing three days of peace, love, and music. What a vibe!

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who we lost on this day in 1977. His music lives on.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: We remember the influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and passed away six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur. His voice and lyrics continue to resonate decades on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Remembered
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. The guitar was never the same.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day in 1969. That album cover, those tracks... pure legend.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders! Still rocking it.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that continues to inspire and resonate across generations.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled its revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? It was released on this day in 2001, changing music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating the iconic spy and over six decades of thrilling cinema. What's your favourite Bond theme?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true icon.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A double album packed with diverse tracks. What's your hidden gem from it?
